description: Call this when the user asks what Bitcoin does on Fed days, how FOMC statements move crypto, or when the next FOMC meeting is. Returns per-statement 5/30/60-minute BTC reactions measured from a minute-resolution record, the average move versus a normal half hour, the up/down split (near a coin flip), and the next meeting date. Description, not prediction.
name: get_fomc_impact
title: Measured FOMC impact on Bitcoin
